title: Filters, column selection, and sort are remembered per browser and restored before the first data fetch
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Set a non-default view: Type = Inventory, date range = Last Month, pick a category, enable Turns / Yr, and sort by Revenue descending.
2. Leave the report (navigate elsewhere), then return to it.
3. Reload the page (browser refresh) and observe again.
custom_expected:
1. On return, every saved setting is restored: Type = Inventory, Last Month, the chosen category, the column set including Turns / Yr, and the Revenue-descending sort.
2. The saved values are applied BEFORE the first data fetch - the report does not flash the defaults and then re-query.
3. The saved values take precedence over the first-visit defaults (This Year / Both / active location / 14 columns / Demand-descending).
4. The same holds after a full page reload.
